selected.titulo: Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents
selected.resumen: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Monday introduced a toolkit of software and hardware products that add independent security layers around AI agents to ensure they stay within their test environments even if they attempt to break out.

selected.titulo: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
selected.resumen: Meta says it will focus on bringing its full technology stack, including Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more to businesses and developers.
